headlines: See The Cost Behind The Fee
Turn Hours Into A Clear Review
descriptions: Busy clients can still have thin margins. Review the cost behind each monthly fee.
Bring fees, hours and costs together. Save the review in your own account.
Explore the fee or hours budget needed for your target delivery margin.

launch_dependencies: Explicit owner approval of campaign, dates and spending limit
Public landing-page access approved by owner
Working subscription checkout and verified conversion measurement
Google Ads account setup and advertiser verification as required

measurement.secondary: First saved review from a new account
measurement.diagnostic: Qualified search clicks; exclude owner and automated tests

decision_rule: Review search relevance and activation after the first 20 qualified clicks or end date. Do not raise the budget automatically. This small test does not establish statistical significance.
economics: Revenue and profit remain zero. Ad spend must be included in net profit; clicks or signups alone do not meet the business goal.
notes: No account has been connected and no campaign has been created in Google Ads.
The CSV contains paused ad rows for a campaign to be configured later; it is not a complete campaign creation file.
Set the total budget directly in the account before launch. Do not replace it with an average daily budget without new approval.
No automatic text generation, expansion to other networks or retargeting is included in this proposal.
